content.text: Co-sleeping at 5 is really common, and kids this age can usually handle a gradual move. Start tonight with a short, steady bedtime routine in his own bed, with you sitting beside it until he's drowsy. Then move your chair a little farther from the bed every few nights, so he learns to fall asleep without you touching or next to him. Also tell him the plan in the daytime, so it's not a surprise at bedtime. Small rewards for staying in his bed, like a sticker chart, tend to help at this age.
